findings.problem: Safety rule S2 is broken by the pack itself. platform-map.md:19-20 and :667-668 say closed or member-only communities are never named as audience leads, but the 에브리타임 (school-verified members only), 네이버 밴드 (member-only groups) and 카카오톡 오픈채팅 (rooms visible only after joining) rows, all 공개 범위 private and out_of_scope, each carry a '사용자 단서(신뢰도 medium)' line, and section 5 (lines 663-666) names 밴드 and 에브리타임 as where the 50-60대 and 학생 users are, two lines before it says the map names no such community. The numbers themselves are right (see verified_facts); the problem is using them as leads.

findings.problem: platform-map.md is too large to be read and repeats itself. 102,653 bytes (62,092 characters, 899 lines) is 2.5 times the ~40 KB flag; section 3 alone is 68,165 bytes (27 rows of about 2.5 KB each). overview.md:32 sends the A1 planning step to this whole file plus statistics.md (42 KB) and never says to open only the rows the plan needs. Exact-duplicate lines make up 18,643 of 101,755 bytes (18%): '- 확인일 2026-09-29 · verified_at 없음(null)' x27 (already stated once in section 1, lines 25-26), the author-key/quote line x14, '- 정당한 경로(선호 순): `reader_public_page`' x12, the 'robots 예상 `unknown`' line x12, the '사용자 단서(신뢰도 `low`): 공개 사용자 구성 자료를 이번 확인에서 찾지 못함...' line x10, and the two most common 예상 중단 lines x14. The same facts are stored again in korea-platforms.json (127 KB), which overview.md:212 calls the source of this file, so the planning phase carries about 230 KB of Korean for one lookup.

findings.problem: The naver-blog row gives a writer age composition ('2025-09 기준 10-30대가 작성자의 약 70%') as a 사용자 단서. Section 1 (platform-map.md:14-16) says 사용자 단서 are platform-user survey or panel values and 'not writer composition', and rule S3 forbids attaching a community's age to posters, claims or personas; the row's own caveat ('한 작성자의 나이를 짐작하는 근거로 쓰지 않음') does not remove the contradiction, because the figure is exactly what an agent would use as a base rate for a blog poster. I also could not reproduce the number: search summaries of the 2025-12-22 '2025 블로그 리포트' coverage confirm 새 글 3억 3천만 건 and 순방문자 4,500만 명 이상, but for age they only give 'What's In My Blog 챌린지 참여자의 80%가 10-30대'; the other reachable figures are older and about other populations (2021 리포트: 이용자의 70%가 10-30대; 2022: 신규 블로그 사용자의 76%가 10-30대). The cited pages P11 (v.daum.net), P12 (zdnet.co.kr) and P13 (fnnews.com) are blocked here, so the pack may be conflating population (users vs writers), period or measure. A settled-sounding number labelled only 미확인(요약).

findings.problem: Wrong disposition for a Supreme Court judgment. 대법원 2023. 10. 26. 선고 2023도1086 quashed the guilty verdict and remanded the case (원심 파기·환송); it is not an acquittal. Only 2021도1533 ended with an acquittal kept (상고 기각). The document itself says this correctly in section 5 (lines 724-732), but four other places call both judgments '무죄'. Line 689 also says '무죄 판결은 허가가 아닙니다' in front of three judgments, one of which (2023도17354) is a conviction upheld. In a checklist that must cite precisely (rule S4) this is a wrong fact, though it fails in the cautious direction.

findings.problem: Section 4b turns a missing disclosure into weak evidence of 'no relationship', which contradicts section 4c and the rest of the pack. For posts after 2024-12-01 read with text_and_images, no disclosure in the title or first part is called '관계 없음의 약한 근거(추론)'. But 4c (line 172), platform-map.md:124 and platform-map.md:657 say 표시가 없다고 협찬이 없는 글로 보지 않음, and the 2024 monitoring found 26.5% of the suspected posts had no disclosure at all: the non-compliant posts are exactly the ones with no label, so a missing label cannot count toward 'no relationship'. It also hands the reader an inference where the pack elsewhere says 'cannot be judged'. The next bullet (line 166, no grade increase) limits the harm, so this is minor.

findings.problem: Ungrammatical seed list: '아이 키우는' is a modifier that needs its noun, but is followed by the object particle 을. It appears in the parent/carer seed rule that the critique asked for (아빠, 육아, 보호자), so the phrase an agent will copy into a query is a fragment.

findings.problem: The same KCA 2024-07-23 survey is described three ways. The JSON hedges the population ('최근 이용 조건은 미확인'), while promotion.md:207 and platform-map.md:636 state '최근 1년 안에 ... 이용한 소비자 1,000명' and statistics.md:124 gives no recency. Every press summary I could reach (kmib, foodnews, viva100, daum) says 최근 1년 이내 배달 플랫폼을 이용한 소비자 1,000명, so the hedge is stale and the three files disagree.
